# gcds-tag



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

A tag is a static label used to categorize, identify, or describe content.

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                                                                     | Type                                                           | Default     |
| -------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `color`  | `color`   | Sets the colour of the tag. Tag colours are decorative and don't carry meaning. | `"blue" \| "gray" \| "green" \| "purple" \| "red" \| "yellow"` | `'gray'`    |
| `size`   | `size`    | Sets the size of the tag.                                                       | `"regular" \| "small"`                                         | `'regular'` |


## Slots

| Slot        | Description                                                                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `"default"` | Slot for the tag text. Text longer than 20 characters is truncated with an ellipsis. |
